data.description: A slurk's back is crusted with thick, dry slime and dozens of nodules.  As a standard action at will, a slurk can squirt a jet of this slime from one of these nodules as a ranged touch attack against any target within 30 feet.  Anyone the slurk successfully bull rushes or overruns is automatically squirted with back slime.  The hardened slime can be removed as a full-round action with a DC 15 Strength check.  The slurk's back slime grants a creature riding it a +8 bonus on Ride checks made to stay in the saddle, but a -8 penalty on Ride checks to dismount.
data.name: Slime
